# white_tube — realism QA

Status: **needs_further_repair**. Grades: evidence B, silhouette B, proportions A, colour_texture C, material B, articulation B, physics B, collision A, instances B, cross_view B. Primary visible IoU: 0.859.

Evidence: f1449, f1451, f1434. Camera intrinsics and metric transforms: `../review/calibration.json`. Comparison: `../review/white_tube_compare.jpg`. Per-frame dimensions, IoU, histogram and mask provenance: `../qa_report.json`.

Changes:
- Added explicit physical schema, material-specific friction, restitution, COM/fragility and honest mass/density priors.
- Updated reproducible meshes, GLB/Blend, collision pieces and calibrated-instance transforms.
- Computed part COM estimates from collision volume; corrected Blender inertial origins without moving canonical visuals.
- Set polymer physical properties and separate white/yellow size/photo variants; refit extents.

Remaining:
- Photometric mismatch remains: illumination, baked label lighting and/or reflective/transmissive appearance need further calibration.
- Source blur/clipping prevents reliable small text and complete silhouette recovery in every view.
- Mass, COM, friction and restitution are unmeasured priors.
- No directly observed manipulation sequence verifies closure forces, thread pitch, flap limits or stiffness.
